remarks: Discover a rare opportunity in the exclusive Highlands on the Lake community on Lake Shore Road. This private, protected lot spans over one acre and offers the best of both worlds—tranquil seclusion with a partially wooded rear portion rich in mature trees, paired with 95 feet of stunning, unobstructed Lake Erie views. From the backyard, residents enjoy convenient access to a shared staircase leading down to a private beach, complete with a cozy built-in bench nestled into the cliff—perfect for pausing to take in the breathtaking vistas and escaping everyday reality.  Just a short walk away lies Frank Lloyd Wright’s iconic Graycliff, the masterpiece he deliberately chose for this very location because of its spectacular lake views. Here you have the rare ability to design a custom home, much as Wright himself did, that complements the incredible natural landscape and unencumbered waterfront views. Adding to the appeal electric already run to the future building site and connected to an existing pool house structure (gas, water and sewer availble), providing a meaningful head start for your new construction.  This beautiful property is currently accessed by a shared driveway, but building a private driveway on this property for access in the future is supported by the building code.
